description: Good decision: env.rs RuntimeEnvironment::from_env() maps both unset and unrecognised STOA_ENV values to Production via a single catch-all arm (_ =>). An operator typo like STOA_ENV=prod silently becomes Production (safe) rather than silently becoming Development (permissive). The asymmetry is intentional and correct: the dangerous mode requires an explicit opt-in string, not just any non-empty value.
title: DECISION: production is fail-safe default for STOA_ENV
